Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AllowMan: Allow ordinary players to delete selected items from their own inventory or nearby world containers in multiplayer.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxFloor: Floor items per type per chunk
Maximum number of floor items with the same fullType in each 8 by 8 chunk. Set to 0 to disable the per-chunk limit.
Floor items per type in scan area
Maximum number of floor items with the same fullType across all chunks in the scan area. Set to 0 to disable the area limit.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_ScanRadi: Radius in squares used to collect chunks around each player for periodic item scans.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_ScanInte: Real-time seconds between periodic floor-item scans and warning confirmations.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_ProtectL: Items never auto-cleaned. Keywords supported: matches item ID (e.g. Base.Log), English name, or translated name (server language). Separate with commas or semicolons.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_TouchTra: Record the last username that touched or dropped an item and show it in the item tooltip.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxAnima: Default stray-animal limit shared by ALL cleanup groups (per group, near each player). Ranched (zone/hutch), named, held or leashed animals are not counted. Use 'Per-group limit overrides' to give specific groups a different value. 0 disables animal cleanup.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalGr: Animal groups allowed to be cleaned. Keywords supported: group key (rat), type key, or translated name (server language), e.g. typing a localized word for rat works. Empty = default rat,mouse,rabbit,chicken.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalLi: Per-group EXCEPTIONS to the default stray limit above. Example: rat=20,rabbit=40 means rat uses 20 and rabbit uses 40, while unlisted groups keep the default. Does NOT affect the ranched-animal limit. Group names accept keywords.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalSc: Chebyshev radius in squares used to assign loaded animals to their nearest player.
Real-time seconds between animal scans and warning confirmations.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxZoneA: Separate limit for animals kept in designation zones or hutches, per group near each player. 0 = never clean ranched animals (full protection, default). Named, held or leashed animals are always protected; strays are removed first.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalZo: Per-group exceptions to the ranched-animal limit above. Example: chicken=80 lets ranched chickens reach 80 while other groups keep the default; 0 = never clean that group's ranched animals. Group names accept keywords.
